[android/](android/README.md)。 | | | |---|---| |
**1 连接手机**：插线即认出手机，内置开启 USB 调试的图文教程 |
**2 检测**：型号、系统版本、机型脚本、快应用、广告组件 | |
**3 选择要关的**：营销通知按渠道勾选，服务类默认不勾 |
**4 执行**：进度条和实时日志 | |
**5 完成**：每一步的结果，最后提醒关闭开发者模式 |

picks.name: rea-video
picks.desc: Reverse-engineer any video, shot by shot: filmed, AI-generated or coded, and how to remake it. Breakdowns in the open VIDEO.md format. 逆向一切视频，逐个镜头看是拍的、AI 生成的还是代码做的，再告诉你怎么复刻；拆解结果按 VIDEO.md 格式输出。
picks.readme:
Reverse-engineer any video. Shot by shot: was it filmed, AI-generated or coded, and how to remake it. Every breakdown is written in **[VIDEO.md](https://videomd.github.io/videomd/)**, an open format that agents read layer by layer. [Website](https://www.reavideo.ai) | [中文](i18n/README_zh.md) | English | [Русский](i18n/README_ru.md) | [日本語](i18n/README_ja.md) | [한국어](i18n/README_ko.md) | [Español](i18n/README_es.md) | [Português](i18n/README_pt.md) | [Français](i18n/README_fr.md) | [Deutsch](i18n/README_de.md) | [Tiếng Việt](i18n/README_vi.md) | [বাংলা](i18n/README_bn.md) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/JuneYaooo/rea-video?style=flat)](https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video/stargazers) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-%E2%89%A53.10-blue) ![Agent](https://img.shields.io/badge/runs%20in-Claude%20Code%20%7C%20Codex-8A2BE2) [![Output: VIDEO.md](https://img.shields.io/badge/output-VIDEO.md-3d4fd6)](https://videomd.github.io/videomd/) [![Visit our website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Visit%20our%20website-6644D8?style=for-the-badge)](https://www.reavideo.ai) [![Join our Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Join%20our%20Discord-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/dZj8D3GqWT) [![WeChat group](https://img.shields.io/badge/WeChat%20group-07C160?style=for-the-badge&logo=wechat&logoColor=white)](i18n/README_zh.md#社区) [![Follow on X](https://img.shields.io/badge/Follow%20%40yao__june12106-000000?style=for-the-badge&logo=x&logoColor=white)](https://x.com/yao_june12106) ⭐ *Help more people find rea-video. Star this repo!* Left: a TikTok ad shot on a phone. Right: an AI remake with another product. rea-video's verdict: the left is all live footage, one set and two camera positions; the right is all AI, 8 shots across 3 generations.
## Quick start rea-video is built for AI agents. In Claude Code, Codex or any agent that can run commands, say: ```text Install https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video, then break down this video: /path/to/video.mp4 ``` The agent installs the CLI, learns the workflow and runs the whole thing. You need ffmpeg and Python 3.10+. Breakdowns are fully upgraded. Each one gives you two outputs: - **Report** (`report.html` / PDF), for you: more reader-friendly, with a clearer structure, easier to learn from and to understand how the video was made and how to remake it. - **[VIDEO.md](https://videomd.github.io/videomd/)**, for your AI: layered, so the AI reads only what a question needs and uses fewer tokens. You can also hook up a video-capable model (Gemini or Doubao both work) by giving the agent its endpoint and key. That makes the live/AI/3D calls more accurate and adds a reverse-engineered prompt for every shot. It works fine without one; if your agent can see images, it checks the uncertain shots itself. > Reports are written in whichever language you ask in (Chinese or English). The example reports below are in English. ## What it can break down | Video type | Examples | What you get | |---|---|---| | Live footage | Talking-head, tabletop, handheld product demo, vlog, store visit | Setups and camera positions, framing, camera moves, lighting (12 setups with gear lists), color grade | | AI video | Text/image-to-video, AI short drama, AI music video | Evidence, a reverse-engineered prompt per shot, how to batch into generations and which model to use | | Avatar | A portrait driven by

picks.name: day-trader-skill
picks.desc: 11 Claude skills for day trading: scan thousands of charts, track breaking news, time every entry and exit, and replay every outcome before you risk a dollar.
picks.readme:
# The Day Trader skill

11 Claude skills for day trading: scan thousands of charts, track breaking news, time every entry and exit, and replay every outcome before you risk a dollar.

Free, MIT, no signup, no API key. The tools are plain Python that read free
public data: Yahoo Finance charts, Nasdaq Trader's symbol lists, SEC EDGAR
and the House Clerk.

One scans thousands of charts for setups. Another tracks breaking news on
every stock you watch. One watches a setup bar by bar and tells you the moment
to get in, and another sets your stop and your target before you do. And the
craziest one is the Time Machine: before you risk a dollar, it replays the
rest of the session 10,000 times from the stock's own recent bars, plus every
past day the same setup fired, and tells you the honest odds.

And no trade goes through until you say yes. Nothing in this pack can place
an order on its own. Paper trading is the default.

> **Looking for the original Trader skill?** Copy an investor's 13F, the
> stock screener, tax lots and rebalancing live in
> [github.com/Jakeschincariol/trader-skill](https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/trader-skill).
> This repo is its day-trading sequel: the Trader skill v2.

## Install

Paste this into Claude:

```
https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/day-trader-skill

install skill
```

Or as a plugin, in Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Jakeschincariol/day-trader-skill
/plugin install day-trader-skill@day-trader-skill
```

Claude Code namespaces plugin skills, so installed as a plugin they show up as
`/day-trader-skill:trader-scanner` and so on. Copy the folders instead if you want
plain `/trader-scanner`:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/day-trader-skill.git
cp -r day-trader-skill/trader-* ~/.claude/skills/
```

Project-local instead of global: copy the same folders into your repo's
`.claude/skills/`. No Claude Code at all? Paste any single `SKILL.md` at the
top of a chat and it runs as a mode. You lose the Python tools, but the method
works.

The tools need Python 3.8 or newer. Nothing to pip install. The SEC tools
(news filings, the analyst) ask you to identify yourself: put your name and
email in `trader/config.json` (`"sec_user_agent": "Your Name you@example.com"`)
or in the `SEC_USER_AGENT` environment variable.

## The eleven

| command | job | what it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/trader-scanner` | Chart Scanner | Scans thousands of charts for setups: opening-range breakouts, flags, oversold bounces. |
| `/trader-news` | News Monitor | Tracks breaking news on every stock you watch and flags what moves it. |
| `/trader-entry` | Entry Timer | Watches a setup bar by bar and tells you the moment to get in. |
| `/trader-exit` | Exit Planner | Sets your stop and your target before you enter, so you know when to get out. |
| `/trader-timemachine` | Time Machine | Replays every possible outcome of a trade before you risk a dollar: 10,000 simulated sessions plus every past time the setup fired. |
| `/trader-risk` | Risk Manager | Checks every trade against your limits and stops anything over them. |
| `/trader-budget` | Budget Manager | Sizes every position to your budget and your max loss per trade. |
| `/trader-broker` | Order Executor | Sends approved orders to your broker, paper trading by default, never without your yes. |
| `/trader-alerts` | Price Alerts | Rings when a price, a stop or the opening bell hits. |
| `/trader-analyst` | Earnings Analyst | Reads earnings reports and sums up what changed. |
| `/trader-pelosi` | Pelosi Tracker | Reads Congress's stock-trade disclosures the minute they are filed. |

## How to use it

Everything lands in a `trader/` folder in your project, and each skill reads
what the last one wrote:

```
scanner -> news -> entry -> exit -> timemachine -> budget -> risk -> broker   (one trade)
alerts: stop, target, flat by the close                                       (while it is open)
news / analyst / pelosi

picks.readme:
# Agent skills from Jane Street

A collection of skills for AI agents and chatbots.
Each skill is a directory containing a `SKILL.md` file
with instructions for the agent.

## Skills

- **socratic-tutor** — turns an LLM into a strict personal tutor that teaches a
  topic of your choice using the Socratic method: a diagnostic, a skill map with
  levels 0-5, one question at a time, spaced review, and a final assessment.

## How to use

With a coding agent that supports the common `SKILL.md` format, copy the skill
directory into your agent's skills folder, then ask the agent to use it
("teach me X").

With a plain chatbot, paste the body of the skill's `SKILL.md` into the chat
(or into a custom/system prompt), followed by what you want it to do.

picks.readme:
# 中小学·高中知识图谱（数学 + 语文 + 科学 + 英语 + 物理 + 历史 + 地理 + 生物 + 化学）

对齐《义务教育数学课程标准（2022 年版 2025 年修订）》（教育部《中小学课程方案和课程标准日常修订版》，教材〔2025〕1 号）、《普通高中数学课程标准（2017年版2025年修订）》的**必修和选择性必修**，以及《义务教育英语课程标准（2022年版）》一级、二级和三级（7–9 年级）和《普通高中英语课程标准（2017年版2025年修订）》的必修、选择性必修。数学教材是人教版一–九、人教 A 版（2019）必修两册和选择性必修三册；英语按人教 PEP（三年级起点，根据2022年版课程标准修订的新版）三上到六上（四下按 2026 春 pep4x_2026 densify；五下新版未上线暂按现行 peps5x densify；六下按现行 peps6x densify）、人教版 Go for it! 新版七上到九上（九下新版未上线，暂按旧版九年级全一册第 9–14 单元等），以及人教版（2019）高中必修三册和选择性必修四册。初中物理按人教版新版（根据2022年版课程标准修订）八年级上册、八年级下册、九年级全一册，对齐《义务教育物理课程标准（2022年版2025年修订）》；高中物理按人教版（2019年审定）必修第一至三册和选择性必修第一至三册，对齐《普通高中物理课程标准（2017年版2020年修订）》。附**自适应前置诊断**与题库。数学答错会沿先修边从高中、初中一直回溯到具体的小学知识点。英语单独成图，不和数学连边；初中英语会连回小学英语，高中英语主要连回初中英语。物理也单独成图，用到的数学写在知识点的 `mathLinks` 字段里，不算先修边。仓库名仍是 `cn-math-taxonomy`。初中生物按人教版七至八年级单独成图，对齐《义务教育生物学课程标准（2022年版）》第四学段内容要求的公开转述；六三制九年级没有生物课。初中化学按人教版九年级上、下册单独成图，对齐《义务教育化学课程标准（2022年版）》第四学段内容要求的公开转述；六三制化学在九年级开设，不建七、八年级化学点，也不采用五四制全一册。高中化学必修第一册、必修第二册、选择性必修第一册《化学反应原理》、选择性必修第二册《物质结构与性质》和选择性必修第三册《有机化学基础》按人教版印刷目录成图，对齐《普通高中化学课程标准（2017年版）》相关内容要求的公开转述。初中语文按统编版七至九年级并入已有语文学科（仍是 `subject=chinese`，编号 `cnc_j`），对齐《义务教育语文课程标准（2022年版）》第四学段学段要求的公开转述（2026-11-06 对照人教社电子书印刷页 14–16；该节没有【内容要求】标题，也未取得教育部 PDF）；小学语文仍是 `cnc_p`。没有高中语文。

**范围：数学高中做到必修和选择性必修，并且只用人民教育出版社 A 版（2019）；英语做到三年级到高中（人教版 2019 必修三册、选择性必修四册）；语文做到小学一至六年级和初中七至九年级（统编版），没有高中语文。** 7.3「复数的三角表示」仍按教材选学处理，没有单独建点。定积分不在选择性必修的内容要求里，没有建点。英语不出听力和口语题。

picks.name: ub-mode
picks.readme:
# ub-mode

`ub-mode` is an agent skill that enforces disciplined software engineering principles when writing or changing code. It is loosely based on portions of [@poteto](https://github.com/poteto)'s rules (`poteto-mode` / `pstack`), reduced and paired with deterministic quality-gate tools:

1. **First Make it Work** — Laziness Protocol, Foundational Thinking, TDD, Redesign From First Principles, Attack the Premise, Subtract Before You Add, Outcome-Oriented Execution, Build the Lever, and Architecture (Model the Domain, Boundary Discipline, Type System Discipline, Make Operations Idempotent, Separate Before Serializing Shared State).
2. **Then Make it Right** — Fix Root Causes, Sequence Work into Verifiable Units, Test Behavior (Not Implementation), [Crapper](https://github.com/unclebob/crapper) (`CRAP < 10`), [Dryer](https://github.com/unclebob/dryer) (duplication `< 0.8`), [Mutator](https://github.com/unclebob/mutator) (cover the uncovered, kill the survivors, delete dead code), and Refactoring.
3. **Practice** — Keep a Log, Guard the Context Window, Worktree Cleanup, and Commit and Push in small ordered commits.

## Companion Tool Repositories

`ub-mode` relies on deterministic quality-gate tools to enforce structure, complexity, duplication, and test thoroughness:

- [unclebob/crapper](https://github.com/unclebob/crapper) — Computes cyclomatic complexity, test coverage, and CRAP score per function so every function stays under the CRAP threshold (`< 10`).
- [unclebob/dryer](https://github.com/unclebob/dryer) — Detects structural code duplication so duplicate blocks (`>= 0.8` similarity) are eliminated.
- [unclebob/mutator](https://github.com/unclebob/mutator) — Runs mutation testing to expose uncovered code and surviving mutants that tests fail to catch.
- [unclebob/uml-viewer](https://github.com/unclebob/uml-viewer) — Visualizes components, coverage, CRAP, mutation scores, and dependency directions.

## Installation

Copy `SKILL.md` into your agent's skills directory as `ub-mode/SKILL.md` (for example `~/.grok/skills/ub-mode/SKILL.md`, `~/.claude/skills/ub-mode/SKILL.md`, or `~/.cursor/skills/ub-mode/SKILL.md`), then invoke `/ub-mode`.

picks.name: ag-ui
picks.desc: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
picks.readme:
# AG-UI: The Agent-User Interaction Protocol AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications. Built for simplicity and flexibility, it enables seamless integration between AI agents, real time user context, and user interfaces. ---

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@ag-ui/core?label=Version&color=6963ff&logo=npm&logoColor=white)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ag-ui/core) ![MIT](https://img.shields.io/github/license/copilotkit/copilotkit?color=%236963ff&label=License) ![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1379082175625953370?logo=discord&logoColor=%23FFFFFF&label=Discord&color=%236963ff) Join our Discord →     Read the Docs →     Go to the AG-UI Dojo →     Follow us → ## 🚀 Getting Started Create a new AG-UI application in seconds: ```bash npx create-ag-ui-app my-agent-app ```

Useful Links:

- [The AG-UI Dojo](https://dojo.ag-ui.com/) - [Build AG-UI-powered applications(Quickstart)](https://docs.ag-ui.com/quickstart/applications) - [Build new AG-UI framework integrations (Quickstart)](https://go.copilotkit.ai/agui-contribute) - [Book a call to discuss an AG-UI integration with a new framework](https://calendly.com/markus-copilotkit/ag-ui) - [Join the Discord Community](https://discord.gg/Jd3FzfdJa8) ## What is AG-UI? AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol for agent-human interaction, designed for simplicity & flexibility: - During agent executions, agent backends **emit events _compatible_ with one of AG-UI's ~16 standard event types** - Agent backends can **accept one of a few simple AG-UI compatible inputs** as arguments **AG-UI includes a flexible middleware layer** that ensures compatibility across diverse environments: - Works with **any event transport** (SSE, WebSockets, webhooks, etc.) - Allows for **loose event format matching**, enabling broad agent and app interoperability It also ships with a **reference HTTP implementation** and **default connector** to help teams get started fast. [Learn more about the specs →](https://go.copilotkit.ai/ag-ui-introduction) ## Why AG-UI? AG-UI was developed based on real-world requirements and practical experience building in-app agent interactions. ## Where does AGUI fit in the agentic protocol stack? AG-UI is complementary to the other 2 top agentic protocols - MCP gives agents tools - A2A allows agents to communicate with other agents - AG-UI brings agents into user-facing applications
## 🚀 Features - 💬 Real-time agentic chat with streaming - 🔄 Bi-directional state synchronization - 🧩 Generative UI
